design.correctness_scope: retrospective source-observation correspondence; not optimality or permanent unrecoverable tracking failure

design.gold_from: actual trajectory that generated fixed views, not which trajectory has most target pixels
design.prompt_language: English only, versioned EN6, validated without submitting requests
